sentences.text: 1. It is stated that the Petitioners have been allowed to travel abroad on earlier occasions.
This Court on 06.10.2023 had permitted the Petitioner to travel abroad.

2. In view of the fact that the Petitioners have been granted permission to travel abroad on earlier occasions, this Court is inclined to permit the Petitioners to travel to Paris, France and London, United Kingdom from 24.11.2023 to 10.01.2024 on the following conditions:-
i.

The Petitioners shall not transfer, alienate or create any third party interest except the SBI home loan mortgage which is already created in respect of the property being H. No.79 First Floor Paschimi Marg Vasant Vihar, Delhi-110057.
ii.
No third party rights shall be created in the above two properties as well.
iii. The Petitioners shall furnish a detailed affidavit disclosing their revised itinerary with updated dates for travel.

The affidavit shall also contain details about their stay at various stations abroad,
telephone numbers and residential/hotel addresses.
The Petitioners shall also file an undertaking that they shall adhere to the itinerary mentioned in the affidavit and not visit any other stations.

iv. The Petitioners shall provide the contact numbers they shall use during the period they stay abroad, and at least one of the said contact numbers will be kept operational at all times, subject to all exceptions,
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

v. The Petitioners shall intimate the Court before leaving and within 72 hours of return from abroad.
vi. The Petitioners shall file self-attested copies of their passports along with a copy of their visa with the Bank, on their return to India.
vii. The permission to travel abroad given in this order shall be subject to other applicable conditions and shall not be deemed as a direction to any other authority.
